name: Study Melbourne Hub welfare support
summary: Walk-in and phone hub in Melbourne CBD offering international students confidential welfare advice, legal help referrals and language help.
key: Confidential advice and support from our international student welfare team
how: Visit 17 Hardware Lane, Melbourne, or call 1800 056 449 (+61 3 9623 1512 from outside Australia)
catches: Open all year from 9 am - 5 pm, Monday to Friday (excluding public holidays)
Category is the closest fit: support service
